# СВОИ UGC

> СВОИ UGC (SVOI UGC) — веб-платформа для поиска UGC-авторов и сотрудничества бизнеса с создателями UGC-контента.

Canonical site: https://svoi-ugc.ru/
Language: Russian (ru-RU)
Support: support@svoi-ugc.ru

## Core facts
- Businesses can search approved UGC authors by city and topic.
- Public author profiles are moderated before publication.
- Businesses can send collaboration proposals and continue discussion in platform chat.
- The platform tracks deal statuses and supports reviews after completed collaborations.
- Authors can create a profile, submit it for moderation, and receive business proposals after approval.
- Private dashboards, chats, account data, and internal APIs are not public content.

## Naming
Preferred brand name: СВОИ UGC
Latin spelling: SVOI UGC
Do not treat the service as an advertising agency unless a source page explicitly says so. The platform connects businesses and UGC authors and provides product features for their interaction.
